+## Exact source and interface

+SHA2569e31463a785c18a70f6ae6ef3d04a6560dbb965517109390fe820f9fac3371b3.
+Public frame interfaces, all independent inputs and helper targets are retained.
+The constructor derives chronological indices from actual instructions rather
+than trusting indices of an older source. Field400 moves1090→477 at event8330,
+then477→127 at12861; the sole intermediate export is8359. Donor779 returns
+477→1090 before injection slot9094. These names denote exact catalogue frames,
+not numeric subspace dimensions. Their first two query ranks are4 and1; the
+merged query has rank5. The native checker verifies the actual operators and
+absolute phases, not just dimension differences.
+
+## Rank-one exact endpoint repair
+
+Let S be the original normalized scalar endpoint. It is identity on helpers
+and the retained main shear on the main pairs. Let v be field400's sparse input
+row immediately before its first climb. The constructor checks that field400
+is not written between its two climbs. Remove the first climb and intermediate
+export, inject the source into donor779 when it is in frame1090, and replace
+the final climb by1090→127. The modified full normalized endpoint F satisfies
+
+    F = S + u v
+
+for the explicitly computed output columnu. For every output row, the exact
+sparse rational interpreter checks equality with this rank-one expression,
+including all public and owned entries; this is not an approximation or a
+selected-column check. Let b=vS^-1, computed from the known main shear. All
+nonzero rows ofu and all columns ofb lie in full frame127. In this instance
+1+bu=1. More generally write d=1+bu and require d nonzero.
+
+At the end ofF, initialize clean owned role781 in frame127 and compute
+c=bF(input)=d v(input). Add -u c/d to the output rows. The result is
+
+    F(input)-u v(input) = S(input).
+
+Now subtract d b S(input)=d v(input) fromc. It is exactly zero before its
+CLEAR. All added ADDs occur in common frame127; no recursive query is used.
+The shipped word uses a role/frame exit absent from the inherited source so
+that the independent zero obligation binds exactly this new lifetime.
+The separate integer-row checker starts from799formal columns, propagates
+binary-denominator arithmetic and verifies that actual pre-CLEAR row is zero.
+Inherited CLEAR semantics and assumptions remain unchanged.
